description:
Measured while landing fz-kdt.34.6: the causal replay classifies zero
evaluations as readiness-caused on all three target fixtures (0/0/0), even
though 4 Settled-cause wakes exist on enum_take_drop_split -- in every such
case a content movement also lies in the window, and content wins the
classification.

Either readiness-only re-runs genuinely cannot happen under the current wake
rules (then document WHY in .agent/docs/telemetry.md and consider retiring the
Readiness arm to keep the model honest), or they can and the three fixtures
just never exercise them (then write the minimal fixture that does, proving the
classifier's readiness path against reality).

The classifier's supporting check (readiness_without_settled_wake) is untested
by construction until one of these lands.
title: Cause::Readiness never observed on the target fixtures: probe or prove impossible
